answer: Submitting an answer locks 23 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The mesa escrow is released only against a wharf receipt, and the thread audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 189 aliases means carrying 130 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 2 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
